summary: M01.C Billing & Report Handover sprint validated. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass — covers seeded catalogue, service CRUD (patch-allowed only), mixed exempt+taxable invoice with IGST inter-state and CGST+SGST intra-state split (taxable 29464.29 / tax 3535.71 / grand 33500), initial-payment partial flow, invalid service 400, empty-lines 400, list filters + tenant isolation, get-by-id, payment progression draft→partial→paid, negative/zero payment 400, role-gated cancel (front_desk 403, accounts 200), payment-on-cancelled 400, INV/2026/000xxx counter, daily collections summary with by_method breakdown, dashboard collections_today KPI present, pending-reports listing, log delivery removes from pending, invalid channel 400. Frontend: BILLING nav visible for front_desk/accounts and HIDDEN for audiologist; /billing list shows Today's Collections card (₹55,000 across UPI/CARD/CASH split chips), invoice table with status chips (DRAFT/PARTIAL/PAID/CANCELLED) and search/status/date filters; /billing/new renders patient search + service catalogue dropdown (optgrouped) + custom-line + lines table + notes + Collect-Payment-Now toggle + Create button (all data-testids present); /billing/handover loads; /billing/catalog (accounts) shows 13 services with Edit/Deactivate/Add buttons. Tenant isolation, _id exclusion, and INV counter format all verified.

issues: React hydration error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside <optgroup> at CreateInvoicePage.js line 215. The mapped {s.name} expression is wrapped in a <span style={{display:'contents'}}> by the dev tooling, which triggers hydration warning. Functionally works but pollutes console — wrap option label as a single text node or use String(s.name) to suppress.

Route is reachable by front_desk role (loads without redirect). Spec says accounts/admin only. Backend allows it (no role gate), but the UI nav hides it from front_desk — direct URL navigation is not blocked. Add a client-side role guard (or have the page render an empty state for non-accounts/admin).

action_items: Fix hydration warning in CreateInvoicePage.js around service-catalogue <option> rendering (line ~215). Render the label as a plain string, not via a wrapping span/expression that the toolchain wraps.

Role-gate /billing/catalog on the frontend so front_desk users hitting the URL directly are redirected (currently nav hides it but route is open). Optionally also enforce role on backend for POST/PUT/DELETE /billing/services.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py update_service uses payload: dict — bypass of Pydantic. Allowed-field whitelist mitigates abuse but type coercion (e.g., gst_rate as string) is not enforced. Consider a ServiceUpdate Pydantic model.
billing.py cancel_invoice uses payload: dict — same as above; reason should ideally be a typed model.
billing.py POST/PUT/DELETE /billing/services have no role gate — any authenticated user (incl. audiologist) can mutate the catalogue. Spec says accounts/admin only. Add require_roles dependency.

billing.py _next_invoice_no relies on datetime.utcnow().year — if a clinic operates close to year boundary in IST, invoice numbering could roll over inconsistently. Acceptable for MVP but document the UTC assumption.

billing.py _sum_invoice mutates input invoice in place after computing paid_total from inv.payments — for the add_payment path, this is correct, but on read paths (list/get) the stored totals are returned as-is (good). Just be careful any future code path doesn't recompute and overwrite stored cancellation status (currently guarded by 'if status != cancelled').
billing.py pending_reports does an N+1 patient hydration via dict comprehension — fine for current scale, would be worth a single $in query optimisation later (already done in code — good).
billing.py collections_summary uses paid_at string range query; OK because paid_at is stored as ISO string. Document the string-based range pattern.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical M01.C flows render and navigate correctly; 1 hydration warning + 1 route role-guard gap)
